findings.title: WAITING selection decisions still drop every eligible alternative
findings.invariant: J04-S01 records every eligible alternative, score input, uncertainty, dependency, and opportunity cost; J04-U02 scoring hides no eligible alternative; R7-V-001 repair claims selection records EVERY eligible alternative including zero-value and below-threshold candidates.
findings.reproduction: Load one ACTIVE project and one READY candidate with expected_value=0.0, uncertainty=1.0, evidence_refs present. Run SelectionService.run(). Decision.status is WAITING, selected_candidate_id None, but decision.alternatives == () and decision.uncertainty == {} even though the candidate passed every eligibility filter and was scored. Same result with a below-threshold positive-value candidate. The SELECTED path records the zero-value candidate correctly; the WAITING path discards it.

findings.title: MissionIntegrator canonical-target binding is still optional and unenforced on the gate dispatch path
findings.invariant: J04-U01: the selected performer must not substitute a different project, repository, recipient, or target after authorization; R7-V-002 repair claims create_mission requires expected_target and enforces canonical-target binding on the kernel dispatch path.
findings.reproduction: After sync_goal, call MissionIntegrator.create_mission(goal_id=..., objective=..., candidate_id=..., decision_id=..., project_target='proving/OTHER') without expected_target. No exception is raised and the mission.created event payload persists project_target='proving/OTHER'. The regression test only proves refusal when expected_target is supplied, and gate_helpers.mission_integration_report (used by journey_gate and restart_gate) calls create_mission without expected_target, so the actual dispatch path never enforces the binding.
